description: Fix the most impactful mobile breakages: (1) legacy non-dark forms (AlumniSignUpForm, AlumniMenu), (2) fixed-width modal/overlay (ProfileDetail — white card at w-[24rem]), (3) Events image gallery Modal (white bg, black text buttons), (4) MaintenancePage and Error page using light bg/insufficient touch targets. These are the highest-visibility regressions on mobile.
steps: Read client/src/components/Error/MaintenancePage.jsx. Replace the light bg-gray-100 background and centered content with: outer div `min-h-screen bg-[#060818] flex flex-col items-center justify-center px-6 py-12`, image `max-w-[180px] sm:max-w-[250px] h-auto mb-8`, h1 `text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-bold text-white mb-4`, p `text-base text-zinc-400 text-center max-w-sm`.

Read client/src/components/Error/Error.jsx. Change `text-red-900` icon/text classes to `text-red-400`. Change the Try Again `<button>` classes to `mt-8 min-h-[44px] rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-6 py-3 text-white hover:bg-blue-500 transition-colors`. The `w-3/4` panel: change `md:w-1/3` to `w-full max-w-sm`.

Read client/src/components/Events/Modal.jsx. Replace the inner white card `bg-white` with `bg-zinc-950/95 border border-zinc-800/80`. Change `text-black` on close/nav buttons to `text-white`. Change `text-3xl font-bold text-black` chevrons to `text-white`. Use `w-full sm:max-w-4xl` instead of `max-w-4xl` so it fills full width on mobile.

Read client/src/components/AlumniNetwork/ProfileDetail.jsx. Replace `w-[24rem] md:w-[26rem]` with `w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-w-[26rem]`. Replace `bg-white text-blue-800` with `bg-zinc-950/95 border border-zinc-800 text-zinc-100`. Change all `text-blue-800` / `text-lg font-bold` to white/zinc colours. Change `flex flex-col md:flex-row items-center w-[80%] ... md:w-[75%]` to `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center w-full gap-2 text-zinc-300 text-sm`. Social icon `<Link>` buttons are already 40×40px (h-10 w-10) — fine.

Read client/src/components/AlumniSignUpForm/AlumniSignUpForm.jsx. Restyle the entire form with dark theme: (a) outer div: replace `bg-black-2 p-6 pt-10 md:p-16` → `bg-[#060818] px-4 py-10 sm:px-8`; (b) logo img: `w-full max-w-[14rem] sm:max-w-[20rem]`; (c) info banner: `flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start gap-3 rounded-2xl border border-amber-500/25 bg-amber-500/10 p-4 mx-0 sm:mx-auto sm:w-fit`; (d) form wrapper `<form>`: replace `bg-gray-800 w-full max-w-lg rounded-lg p-2 md:p-8` → `w-full max-w-lg rounded-2xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.04] backdrop-blur-xl p-5 sm:p-8`; (e) ALL `<input className="bg-gray-200 w-full rounded p-2 text-black">` → `w-full rounded-xl border border-white/[0.08] bg-white/[0.05] px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-white placeholder-zinc-500 outline-none focus:border-blue-500/50 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500/30`; (f) ALL `<label>` classes `text-white` → `text-zinc-400`; (g) submit button: `w-full rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-600 to-cyan-500 py-3 text-sm font-bold text-white min-h-[44px] hover:from-blue-500 hover:to-cyan-400 transition-all`; (h) `Already registered?` text: `text-zinc-400`; (i) `<select>` elements: use same dark input class as inputs above.

Read client/src/components/AlumniDetail/AlumniMenu.jsx. (a) `<section>` wrapper: add `px-4 sm:px-8 overflow-hidden w-full` and remove any fixed widths. (b) Inside the form, each field `<div className="m-4 flex w-full flex-col gap-2 md:w-fit">` → `flex w-full flex-col gap-2 mb-4`. (c) Each `<input className="w-full border-b border-blue-600 bg-transparent outline-none md:w-[20rem]">` → remove `md:w-[20rem]`, keep `w-full`. (d) Image upload area: center, `w-full`. (e) Submit `<button>`: add `w-full sm:w-auto min-h-[44px] rounded-xl` classes.
acceptance_criteria: MaintenancePage renders on dark background with white text at 360px viewport — no light bg visible
Error page Try Again button is at least 44px tall with rounded styling
Events image gallery modal has dark background, white close/nav buttons, fills full viewport width on mobile
AlumniNetwork ProfileDetail modal is at most viewport-width minus 2rem, dark themed, readable on 360px
AlumniSignUpForm shows dark card, all inputs have dark styling and are full-width on mobile
AlumniMenu form inputs are full-width on mobile, submit button has adequate touch target
`CI=false npm run build` completes without errors after all changes
verification: cd c:\Users\Lenovo\Nexus\client && CI=false npm run build

npm start — open http://localhost:3000 in Chrome DevTools at 360×640 and visually inspect: /alumni/signup (dark form), /alumni-network/alumni (ProfileDetail modal), open Events page and gallery modal, trigger an error state for MaintenancePage
findings: All 6 components updated successfully. Build passed (exit 0) with only pre-existing ESLint warnings in unrelated files. Key findings: (1) AlumniSignUpForm had pre-existing ESLint warnings (no-fallthrough, duplicate-case) in handleChange switch — not introduced by this change. (2) AlumniMenu section wrapper already had overflow-hidden; kept it and added px-4 sm:px-8 and w-full. (3) Events Modal inner card changed from max-w-4xl to sm:max-w-4xl so it is full-width on mobile. (4) ProfileDetail modal card now uses w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] max-w-[26rem] — fits any mobile viewport. (5) All dark-theme classes follow the project glass-card pattern: bg-white/[0.04] backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/[0.08].
